paragraphs.en: You never know when at any second something might happen that you might need it. That's the point.
paragraphs.zh: 你永远不知道什么时候会发生一些事让你用到枪。这才是重点。

paragraphs.en: It's not that you think it's going to. It's that you recognize the possibility that it can.
paragraphs.zh: 不是说你认为它会发生，而是你必须意识到，有需要用到枪的可能性。

paragraphs.en: You recognize the possibility that there are evil people in the world who do evil things and you have to be able to protect yourself against that.
paragraphs.zh: 你要认识到世界上存在作恶之人这种可能性，而且你必须有能力保护自己免受其害。

paragraphs.en: I think I'm an average gun owner because, I mean, I'm an average guy.
paragraphs.zh: 我想我是个普通的持枪人，因为我就是个普通人。

paragraphs.en: I mean, there's nothing really special about me. From an early age, Dad would go out hunting, I went with him.
paragraphs.zh: 我并没有什么特别之处。从很小的时候，爸爸就会带我一起去打猎。

paragraphs.en: You know, I was always in the woods with him shooting and you know, at the range shooting, and, you know, that's just, it was a way of life.
paragraphs.zh: 我总是和他一起在树林里射击，有时候也在靶场练枪，这只是一种生活方式。

paragraphs.en: We're going to the Minerva Sportsman's Club, a local range that I'm a member of.
paragraphs.zh: 我们要去密涅瓦运动员俱乐部，这是一个我加入的本地射击场。

paragraphs.en: This is my AR-15 pistol, Hungarian AK-47, Marlin Model 60-22 rifle, Heritage Rough Rider, the U.S.-made rifle that's kind of a cross between an AK-47 and an AR-15, Spanish police pistol, SKS rifle, little Taurus TX-22, Ruger Mini-14.
paragraphs.zh: 这是我的AR-15手枪，匈牙利AK-47，马林60-22型步枪、Heritage左轮手枪、介于AK-47和AR-15之间的美国产步枪、西班牙警用手枪，SKS步枪、陶鲁斯TX-22手枪、鲁格Mini-14步枪。

paragraphs.en: I own more than a dozen firearms and less than I want. Well, for several different reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 我有十几把枪，但我还想要更多。原因有很多。

paragraphs.en: Like any other tool, specific firearms are for specific purposes.
paragraphs.zh: 就像其他工具一样，特定的枪支针对特定的目的。

paragraphs.en: I have rifles that are just simply, strictly for accuracy to try to put holes in a piece of paper far away. I have firearms for hunting.
paragraphs.zh: 我买步枪纯粹是为了追求精准度，让我能在远处击穿靶纸。我有用于狩猎的枪支。

paragraphs.en: The majority of my firearms though are for defensive purposes. Over a period of years, that's what most people do.
paragraphs.zh: 不过，我的大部分枪支都是用于自卫的。多年来，大多数人都是这么做的。

paragraphs.en: They get one here, then they get one there, then they get another one. Sometimes they tell their wife, sometimes they don't.
paragraphs.zh: 他们逛完这家武器商店又去另一家，然后又买了一把。有时他们会告诉妻子，有时候不会。

paragraphs.en: Sometimes they just, 'Oh no, I've had that one for a while. Yeah, don't you remember I bought that back then?' That's right.
paragraphs.zh: 有时他们只是说：“这把枪我买了有一段时间了。你不记我什么时候买的吗？”没错。

paragraphs.en: So, this is Jason Spoon. He's a friend of mine and a firearms instructor.
paragraphs.zh: 这是杰森·斯波恩。他是我的朋友，也是一名枪械教练。

paragraphs.en: His family runs the local gun shop here in town. What'd you bring with us today? I brought a duty pistol and a Henry Golden Boy. Nice. Classic.
paragraphs.zh: 他的家人在镇上经营着当地的枪支店。你今天带了什么来？我带了一把值勤手枪和一把亨利金童步枪。不错，很经典。

paragraphs.en: I think between all of us, we have some pretty good representations of what kind of stuff people own around here.
paragraphs.zh: 我想看看我们两人的枪， 你就能知道这附近的人都有什么枪了，他们有的我们都有。

paragraphs.en: Alright, let's go get some targets. It's wonderful if you're a duck.
paragraphs.zh: 来打两枪吧。如果你是只鸭子那就好了。

paragraphs.en: It's a horrible downpour but, you know, I don't really mind shooting at it once in a while because you can't always pick when you might have to shoot.
paragraphs.zh: 这雨下得可真大，但我并不介意偶尔在大雨中射击，因为在真正需要开枪的时候，你可没有那么多选择。
